Ranks Montgomery census tracts by adult asthma prevalence from CDC PLACES and left-joins each tract's pre-aggregated 2025 code-violation count, keeping tracts without violations as zero and geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH cdc AS (
  SELECT tractfips,
         CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_rate,
         CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS adult_population
  FROM session.fw_393262_m1_cdc
  WHERE casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
),
viol AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS code_violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_393262' AND source = 'm2_city' AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
       c.adult_asthma_rate,
       c.adult_population,
       COALESCE(v.code_violations_2025, 0) AS code_violations_2025,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
LEFT JOIN cdc AS c ON c.tractfips = t.geoid
LEFT JOIN viol AS v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
WHERE c.adult_asthma_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY adult_asthma_rate DESC, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
